nameOfQualification: Post Graduate Certificate Programme in VLSI Design
description: The course aims to encourage the students to enable them to work on VLSI domain as well as prepare them to keep pace with the changing face of technology and the requirements of the growing Semiconductor industry. This course will assist engineers who wish to gain theoretical as well as practical knowledge in the field of Very Large-Scale Integration (VLSI) design. It will also prepare them to keep pace with the changing trends of VLSI technology and the requirements of an ever-growing VLSI design industry. These candidates will be trained in Verilog HDL, Advanced Digital Design, Synthesis, FPGA, CMOS, ASIC , System Verilog, UVM, Project development and Business communication skills. After doing this course students can work as Design engineer/Verification engineer / FPGA Engineer/ASIC engineer/ Application engineer.
